name: Sega Dreamcast
_notes: Dreamcast face labels sit where Xbox's do, so positional and label-match agree. Triggers are analog only (no digital pair). rumble=true assumes a Puru Puru / Jump Pack. Flycast exposes extra inputs (second stick, D-pad 2, C/Z for arcade sticks) that are left out; the arcade stick, light gun and keyboard aren't modelled. NAOMI/Atomiswave use arcade.json.
